title: The Missing Silk Sash
scene: At 12:15 PM, the silk wedding sash vanished from the fitting room. Only the tailor saw the bent brass pin left on the velvet stool.

suspects.name: Priya Nair
suspects.testimony: I browsed lace trims by the window from 12:00 to 12:20 PM—I never dropped any bent brass pin!
suspects.contradiction: Nobody had mentioned a bent brass pin, and ivory silk threads clung to Priya's handbag clasp.

suspects.name: Celeste Moreau
suspects.testimony: I pressed linens in the front shop from 11:55 AM to 12:15 PM before stepping into the fitting room.
suspects.alibiProof: Two bridesmaids chatted with Celeste at the front ironing board from 11:55 AM to 12:15 PM.

suspects.name: Gavin O'Brien
suspects.testimony: I measured wool bolts at the table right outside the fitting room curtain from 12:00 to 12:20 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: The shop assistant helped Gavin unroll wool bolts outside the curtain from 12:00 to 12:20 PM.

suspects.name: Oliver Kent
suspects.testimony: I cleaned camera lenses on the porch bench from 11:55 AM to 12:20 PM and never went inside.
suspects.alibiProof: The florist next door waved to Oliver on the porch bench at 12:05 and 12:15 PM.
